label: class_d_04_language_01
text: Aujourd’hui—today—we take our midterm exam!\nDétendez-vous—relax, that is—and do your best![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_04_language_02
text: Êtes-vous prêts—are you ready? Let’s begin![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_04_question_01
text:
1. Gracias, arigato, merci, and xièxie all share
    the same meaning. What is it?

A) Thank you
B) Good-bye
C) Good night

label: class_d_04_question_02
text:
2. Which of the following means “delicious”?

A) Au revoir
B) Délicieux
C) Nǐhǎo

label: class_d_04_question_03
text:
3. Which of these phrases doesn’t belong?

A) Ich liebe dich
B) Je t’aime
C) Te amo
D) Time to eat

label: class_d_04_question_04
text:
4. When speaking with a person, what is the
    first step to smooth communication?

A) Compliment them
B) Get mad at them
C) Bury them in flattery

label: class_d_04_question_05
text:
5. What is your beloved teacher’s name?

A) Theodore
B) Leonore
C) Salvatore
D) Salvador

label: class_d_04_language_03
text: C’est fini! Time is up! Posez vos stylos—put down\nyour pens, that is![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_04_language_04
text: I hope that was easy enough for you. Especially\nthat dernière question—that last question![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

label: class_d_04_language_05
text: I’m sure you all did great! Bravo, my friends! You\ncan check your scores at the school’s front desk.[VAR 0x0114(0026)]
